entries.zh: 恒心；坚守不移，固守（胶守）
entries.en: constancy, steadfastness; perseverance; to hold fast (as if glued)
entries.notes: 西语栏尾语 "no alcan camam" 未能确解，R 栏对音亦难与 H 栏"胶守"对应；据词头 Constancia 与 H、M 两栏定恒心坚守义。

entries.zh: 星座；星宿〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: H、R 两栏空缺，M 栏仅存单音无从比定汉字，释义仅据西语词头 Constelacion 推定。

entries.zh: 亲家（儿女婚配后两家父母互称）
entries.en: consuegro: co-father-in-law; the in-law relation between the families of one's child's spouse (qinjia)

entries.zh: 敝亲家（谦称自己的亲家）
entries.en: my (humble) co-father-in-law; self-deprecating form of qinjia

entries.zh: 对头：姻亲之对方、亲家；另义冤家、对手
entries.en: co-father-in-law; the counterpart family in a marriage alliance; also 'adversary, enemy'
to deliberate, consult; to discuss a matter
to consult in secret; secret counsel, private plotting

entries.zh: 国政：商议国事，王国政务
entries.en: affairs of state of the kingdom; to deliberate on them

entries.zh: 公议：公众共同商议之事（乡里公议）
entries.en: public consultation; matters deliberated by the town or community

entries.zh: 相国：宰相，辅佐君王共商国政的大臣
entries.en: chancellor / prime minister of a state (xiangguo); minister who deliberates state affairs with the king
entries.notes: 西语栏 "m̃abley" 为手稿缩写或讹形，未能确解；据 H 栏"相国"及 M、R 两栏对音定宰相辅政义。

entries.zh: 背后议论人，窃窃私议（淡/谈人议论）
entries.en: to consult while murmuring; to gossip about others, talk behind their backs
entries.notes: H 栏首字带[疑]（淡/谈），R 栏对音与 M 栏未逐一对应；据西语 murmurando 及"人议论"定窃议他人义。

entries.zh: 议论：商讨，评议（原注 ut sic，示例如下）
entries.en: consultation, discussion; deliberation (ut sic = 'as shown here')
to consume, spend; to lose, waste, impair

entries.zh: 荒废：使家产荒废，耗散家业
entries.en: to squander or let fall to ruin one's estate, property

entries.zh: 漏空：因狎妓而漏尽掏空家产
entries.en: to squander and hollow out one's estate through women; drain one's wealth on women

entries.notes: M 栏并列三个音形且其一被标为 T99 污损难辨，未能逐一比定；据西语 Contar 与 H 栏"算"定计数义。
